calls.thesis: Stock -30% on AI-agent booking disruption fears (Meta's 'News' agent + Expedia partnership), but business still superb: ~25% net margins, P/FCF ~14, 5%/yr buybacks; his weighted 3-scenario model rates it HOLD, not buy, at $162.
calls.base_case: Normal: 11% EPS growth 5y, fair PE 18 -> fair value $220 (+35%); buy price ~$164.
calls.bull_case: Positive scenario: higher growth, fair PE 21 -> expected return >17%/yr.
calls.bear_case: Negative (35% weight): AI agents take over, EPS declines 2%/yr -> fair PE 11, ~$42 (-73%).
